name: Machikado Shoujo
source:
Spending a sweet moment of time with a girl you just met.. 

The street is the same as ever. The scenery hasn't changed. 

You (protagonist) are a workaday salary man. 
Every day is another grueling drudge. You seemed 
destined to live the same boring day after day forever.

Then you met the girl in the school uniform... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095851.html]DLsite English[/url]]
